objective: Match pairs of legs to the hypotenuse of the right triangle.

stem.en: Match each pair of legs to the length of the hypotenuse of the right triangle.
stem.es: Relaciona cada par de catetos con la longitud de la hipotenusa del triángulo rectángulo.

hints.en: Square both legs and add them.
Take the square root of the sum.
The hypotenuse must be longer than both legs.

steps: 20² + 21² = 841 and 9² + 40² = 1681, so the hypotenuses are 13, 17, 29 and 41.

objective: Match lines through the origin to their equations using the slope.

stem.en: Each line goes through the origin and the point shown. Match the line to its equation.
stem.es: Cada recta pasa por el origen y por el punto indicado. Relaciona la recta con su ecuación.

hints.en: A line through the origin has the form y = kx.
Find k by dividing the y-coordinate by the x-coordinate.
Compute y ÷ x for each point.

steps: Each value is the slope k in y = kx.

objective: Sort equations into linear and nonlinear functions.

stem.en: Sort each equation by whether it defines a linear function or a nonlinear function.
stem.es: Clasifica cada ecuación según si define una función lineal o una función no lineal.

hints.en: Linear equations can be written as y = mx + b.
If x is squared, cubed, or in a denominator, the graph is not a line.
Try rewriting y = 3(x + 4) in slope-intercept form.

steps: y = 5x − 2, y = x/2 + 7 and y = 3x + 12 are all of the form mx + b.
x², x³ and 10/x do not give a constant rate of change.
solution.es: Las lineales se escriben como mx + b; x², x³ y 10/x no dan tasa constante.

objective: Plot the intersection point of two lines as the solution of a system.

stem.en: The lines y = x + 1 and y = −x + 5 cross at exactly one point. Plot that point to show the solution of the system.
stem.es: Las rectas y = x + 1 y y = −x + 5 se cruzan en un solo punto. Marca ese punto para mostrar la solución del sistema.

hints.en: The solution is the point that is on both lines.
Where the two y-values are equal, the lines meet.
Set x + 1 equal to −x + 5 and solve for x, then find y.

solution.es: x + 1 = −x + 5 da x = 2 y y = 3. Marca (2, 3).

objective: Use a scale factor to find a side length of a similar figure.

stem.en: A right triangle has sides 3, 4 and 5 inches. A similar triangle is made with a scale factor of 2.5. How long is the longest side of the new triangle, in inches?
stem.es: Un triángulo rectángulo tiene lados de 3, 4 y 5 pulgadas. Se hace un triángulo semejante con un factor de escala de 2.5. ¿Cuánto mide el lado más largo del nuevo triángulo, en pulgadas?

hints.en: Every side of the new triangle is the matching side times the scale factor.
Find the longest side of the original triangle first.
Multiply that side by 2.5.

solution.es: El lado más largo original es 5; 5 × 2.5 = 12.5 pulgadas.

objective: Use a function machine to see that one input gives one output.

stem.en: This function machine gives exactly one output for each input. Feed in the input 4 and read the output.
stem.es: Esta máquina de funciones da exactamente una salida para cada entrada. Introduce la entrada 4 y lee la salida.

hints.en: Choose the button that feeds a number into the machine.
The machine follows the same rule every time.
The table shows the pair (input, output) once you feed in 4.

steps: The rule multiplies by 3 and adds 2.
solution.es: La regla multiplica por 3 y suma 2: la entrada 4 da 3(4) + 2 = 14.

objective: Find the distance between two points on a coordinate plane.

stem.en: Two towns are at (1, 2) and (7, 10) on a map grid where each unit is 1 kilometer. How many kilometers apart are the towns?
stem.es: Dos pueblos están en (1, 2) y (7, 10) en una cuadrícula de mapa donde cada unidad es 1 kilómetro. ¿A cuántos kilómetros están los pueblos?

hints.en: Draw a right triangle with the segment between the towns as its hypotenuse.
Find the horizontal and vertical differences.
Use the Pythagorean theorem with those two legs.

objective: Solve a system by substitution when one equation gives y in terms of x.

stem.en: A bag has twice as many red marbles (y) as blue marbles (x), and 18 marbles in all. So y = 2x and x + y = 18. How many blue marbles are in the bag?
stem.es: Una bolsa tiene el doble de canicas rojas (y) que de canicas azules (x), y 18 canicas en total. Así que y = 2x y x + y = 18. ¿Cuántas canicas azules hay en la bolsa?

hints.en: Replace y in the second equation with the expression equal to y.
That gives an equation with only x.
Combine like terms and divide.

objective: Interpret the rate of change in a linear model.

stem.en: A taxi charges C = 25 + 4m dollars for a ride of m miles. What does the 4 mean in this situation?
stem.es: Un taxi cobra C = 25 + 4m dólares por un viaje de m millas. ¿Qué significa el 4 en esta situación?

text.en: The ride costs 4 dollars more for each mile
text.es: El viaje cuesta 4 dólares más por cada milla

text.en: The ride has a starting charge of 4 dollars
text.es: El viaje tiene un cargo inicial de 4 dólares

choices.why: The starting charge is the constant 25, the cost when m = 0. The 4 is multiplied by m, so it is a rate.

text.en: The taxi travels 4 miles in all
text.es: El taxi viaja 4 millas en total

choices.why: The number of miles is the variable m. The 4 is a price, not a distance.

text.en: The ride costs 25 dollars for each 4 miles
text.es: El viaje cuesta 25 dólares por cada 4 millas

choices.why: The 25 is charged once, and 4 dollars is charged for every mile.

hints.en: Look at which part is multiplied by m.
The coefficient of m tells the change in cost for each mile.
The constant by itself is the cost when m = 0.

steps: Cost grows by 4 dollars each time m goes up by 1.
So 4 is the cost per mile, the rate of change.
solution.es: El costo sube 4 dólares por cada milla: 4 es la tasa de cambio.

verify.note: Interpreting a coefficient in context is a reasoning judgment, not a numeric calculation.

objective: Interpret the slope of a linear model in context.

stem.en: A linear model for the height h in inches of children is h = 2.4a + 31, where a is age in years. What does the 2.4 tell you?
stem.es: Un modelo lineal para la estatura h en pulgadas de los niños es h = 2.4a + 31, donde a es la edad en años. ¿Qué te dice el 2.4?

text.en: The model predicts a child grows about 2.4 inches for each additional year of age
text.es: El modelo predice que un niño crece unas 2.4 pulgadas por cada año adicional de edad

text.en: The model predicts a newborn is 2.4 inches tall
text.es: El modelo predice que un recién nacido mide 2.4 pulgadas

choices.why: The predicted height at age 0 is the constant 31, not the 2.4.
The age is the variable a. The 2.4 multiplies a.

text.en: The model predicts a 31-inch child is 2.4 years old
text.es: El modelo predice que un niño de 31 pulgadas tiene 2.4 años

choices.why: The 2.4 is a rate of growth, not an age.

hints.en: The slope multiplies the input variable.
It tells how much the output changes when the input increases by 1.
Here the input is age and the output is height.

steps: The coefficient of a is the slope.
It means height goes up 2.4 inches per year of age.
solution.es: El coeficiente de a es la pendiente: 2.4 pulgadas más por cada año.

verify.note: Interpreting the slope of a linear model in words is a reasoning judgment.

objective: Convert a repeating decimal with a non-repeating digit to a fraction.

stem.en: A measuring app shows 0.1666… liter, where only the 6 repeats. Write that amount as a fraction in simplest form.
stem.es: Una aplicación de medición muestra 0.1666… litros, donde solo se repite el 6. Escribe esa cantidad como una fracción en su forma más simple.

hints.en: Only the 6 repeats, so move the decimal point until the repeating part starts right after it.
Compare 10x and 100x, then subtract so the repeating tails cancel.
The subtraction leaves a whole number equal to 90 times x.

objective: Find the error in claiming a reflection changes size.

stem.en: A triangle has sides 6, 8 and 10. Ana reasons about its reflection. Step 1: The perimeter is 6 + 8 + 10 = 24. Step 2: The image is a mirror image. Step 3: A mirror image looks smaller, so the image sides are 3, 4 and 5. Step 4: The image perimeter is 12. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Un triángulo tiene lados de 6, 8 y 10. Ana razona sobre su reflexión. Paso 1: El perímetro es 6 + 8 + 10 = 24. Paso 2: La imagen es una imagen de espejo. Paso 3: Una imagen de espejo parece más pequeña, así que los lados de la imagen son 3, 4 y 5. Paso 4: El perímetro de la imagen es 12. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

steps: The image is a mirror image
A mirror image looks smaller, so the sides are 3, 4 and 5

hints.en: Recall which properties a reflection keeps.
A reflection is a rigid motion, so it does not change side lengths.
Decide whether the image sides should be 6, 8 and 10 or something different.

steps: Reflections preserve side lengths, so the image sides are still 6, 8 and 10.
solution.es: La reflexión conserva las longitudes: el perímetro de la imagen sigue siendo 24.

objective: Solve for an unknown exponent in a scientific-notation product.

stem.en: A lab multiplies two measurements: (2 × 10ⁿ)(4 × 10³) = 8 × 10⁹. Solve for n.
stem.es: Un laboratorio multiplica dos mediciones: (2 × 10ⁿ)(4 × 10³) = 8 × 10⁹. Resuelve para n.

hints.en: The product of the single digits is 8 on both sides, so compare the powers of ten.
Add the exponents on the left side.
Write n + 3 = 9 and solve.

objective: Find the error of treating the hypotenuse as a leg.

stem.en: A right triangle has one leg of 9 and a hypotenuse of 15. Rae finds the other leg x. Step 1: 9² + 15² = x². Step 2: 81 + 225 = 306. Step 3: x = √306. Which step has the first mistake?
stem.es: Un triángulo rectángulo tiene un cateto de 9 y una hipotenusa de 15. Rae halla el otro cateto x. Paso 1: 9² + 15² = x². Paso 2: 81 + 225 = 306. Paso 3: x = √306. ¿Qué paso tiene el primer error?

hints.en: Check whether the answer x is shorter than the hypotenuse 15.
The hypotenuse is the longest side, so it goes by itself on one side.
Write the equation as 9² + x² = 15².

steps: The hypotenuse must be alone: 9² + x² = 15².
solution.es: La hipotenusa va sola: 9² + x² = 15², x² = 144 y x = 12.

objective: Use a linear model equation to make a prediction.

stem.en: A model for a delivery fee is y = 2.5x + 4, where x is the number of kilometers. What fee does the model predict when x = 6?
stem.es: Un modelo para una tarifa de entrega es y = 2.5x + 4, donde x es el número de kilómetros. ¿Qué tarifa predice el modelo cuando x = 6?

choices.why: That is 2.5 × 6 and leaves out the 4 that is added.
That adds all three numbers. The 2.5 multiplies x, so multiply 2.5 by 6 first.
That adds 6 + 4 and ignores the 2.5. The 2.5 multiplies x.

hints.en: Replace x with 6 in the equation.
Multiply 2.5 by 6 first.
Then add 4.

objective: Find the distance between points with negative coordinates.

stem.en: What is the distance between the points (−3, −1) and (2, 11)?
stem.es: ¿Cuál es la distancia entre los puntos (−3, −1) y (2, 11)?

choices.why: That adds the horizontal and vertical differences (5 + 12). Distance comes from the Pythagorean theorem.
That subtracts the differences (12 − 5). Use both differences as legs of a right triangle.
That is the sum of the squares. Take the square root to get the distance.

hints.en: Find how far apart the x-coordinates are and how far apart the y-coordinates are.
Be careful with the negative numbers when you subtract.
Use the two differences as the legs of a right triangle.

objective: Find the cube root of a negative perfect cube.

stem.en: What is the value of ∛(−27)?
stem.es: ¿Cuál es el valor de ∛(−27)?

hints.en: Ask which number multiplied by itself three times gives −27.
A negative number times itself three times stays negative.
Try (−3) · (−3) · (−3) and check the sign at each step.

objective: Write a negative power as a unit fraction.

stem.en: A dust particle is 5⁻³ millimeter across. Write 5⁻³ as a fraction.
stem.es: Una partícula de polvo mide 5⁻³ milímetros de ancho. Escribe 5⁻³ como una fracción.

hints.en: A negative exponent means take the reciprocal.
Write 1 over the positive power of 5.
Compute 5 × 5 × 5 for the denominator.

objective: Evaluate a power with a negative integer exponent.

stem.en: A scientist records a length of 4⁻² meters. Write 4⁻² as a fraction.
stem.es: Un científico anota una longitud de 4⁻² metros. Escribe 4⁻² como una fracción.

hints.en: A negative exponent means take the reciprocal of the power.
4⁻² is 1 divided by a positive power of 4.
Work out 4² first and put 1 over it.

objective: Read the slope from an equation in slope-intercept form.

stem.en: The temperature of a cooling drink is modeled by y = −3x + 8. What is the slope of this line?
stem.es: La temperatura de una bebida que se enfría se modela con y = −3x + 8. ¿Cuál es la pendiente de esta recta?

hints.en: In y = mx + b, the slope is the number multiplying x.
Keep the sign of the number in front of x.
Ignore the constant term when you look for the slope.

steps: The equation has the form y = mx + b.
The coefficient of x is −3, so the slope is −3.
solution.es: En y = mx + b la pendiente es el coeficiente de x: −3.

objective: Solve a linear equation whose solution is negative.

stem.en: Find the value of x that makes both sides balance: 7 − 2x = x + 22.
stem.es: Halla el valor de x que equilibra ambos lados: 7 − 2x = x + 22.

hints.en: Gather the x terms on one side by adding 2x to both sides.
Then subtract 22 from both sides.
Divide by the coefficient of x and watch the signs.

objective: Evaluate a negative base raised to an odd power.

stem.en: Mira evaluates (−2)³ for a game score. What is the value of (−2)³?
stem.es: Mira calcula (−2)³ para una puntuación de un juego. ¿Cuál es el valor de (−2)³?

hints.en: The exponent 3 means three factors of −2.
Multiply two of the factors first and watch the sign.
Then multiply by the third −2.

objective: Identify a relation in which one input has two outputs.

stem.en: Each set below lists (input, output) pairs. Which set is NOT a function?
stem.es: Cada conjunto de abajo muestra pares (entrada, salida). ¿Cuál conjunto NO es una función?

choices.why: Each input 1, 2 and 3 appears once, so each has exactly one output. This is a function.
Different inputs may share an output. Each input here still has exactly one output, so it is a function.
Each input appears once, so this is a function.

hints.en: A function gives each input exactly one output.
Look for an input that appears more than once.
Check whether a repeated input is paired with different outputs.

steps: In set C the input 2 is paired with both 1 and 6.
One input with two outputs means it is not a function.
solution.es: En el conjunto C, la entrada 2 tiene salidas 1 y 6, así que no es función.

verify.note: Function-definition recognition; judged by checking inputs for repeats rather than by a numeric computation.

objective: Recognize equivalent forms of a negative-exponent value.

stem.en: One of the expressions below does not equal 1/8. Which one is the odd one out?
stem.es: Una de las expresiones de abajo no es igual a 1/8. ¿Cuál es la diferente?

choices.why: 2⁻³ = 1/2³ = 1/8, so this one does equal 1/8.
8⁻¹ = 1/8, so this one does equal 1/8.
(1/2)³ = 1/8, so this one does equal 1/8.

hints.en: Evaluate each choice and compare it with 1/8.
A negative exponent gives a reciprocal, but a minus sign in front gives a negative number.
Check the choice that has a minus sign instead of a negative exponent.

objective: Classify systems by the number of solutions.

stem.en: Sort each system by how many solutions it has.
stem.es: Clasifica cada sistema según cuántas soluciones tiene.

hints.en: Compare the slopes of the two lines first.
Same slope and different y-intercepts means the lines never meet. Same slope and same intercept means they are the same line.
Rewrite each second equation in the form y = mx + b if needed.

steps: Different slopes meet once: y = x + 4 with y = 2x, and y = 3x with y = x + 8.
Same slope, different intercept: no solution. Same line: infinitely many.
solution.es: Pendientes distintas: una solución; misma pendiente y distinta intersección: ninguna; la misma recta: infinitas.

objective: Write and solve an equation from the angle sum of a triangle.

stem.en: The angles of a triangle measure x°, 2x° and 3x°. Since the angles of a triangle add to 180°, solve x + 2x + 3x = 180.
stem.es: Los ángulos de un triángulo miden x°, 2x° y 3x°. Como los ángulos de un triángulo suman 180°, resuelve x + 2x + 3x = 180.

hints.en: Combine the like terms on the left side first.
You will have a single multiple of x equal to 180.
Divide both sides by that multiple.

objective: Place the opposite of a perfect-square root on a number line.

stem.en: Place a point at −√9 on the number line from −5 to 0.
stem.es: Coloca un punto en −√9 en la recta numérica de −5 a 0.

hints.en: First find √9 by itself.
The minus sign in front means the opposite of that number.
Count that many units left of 0.

solution.es: √9 = 3, así que −√9 = −3, tres unidades a la izquierda de 0.

objective: Choose the missing leg of a right triangle given the hypotenuse and a leg.

stem.en: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of 10 and one leg of 6. What is the length of the other leg?
stem.es: Un triángulo rectángulo tiene una hipotenusa de 10 y un cateto de 6. ¿Cuál es la longitud del otro cateto?

choices.why: That subtracts the side lengths (10 − 6). Use squares: c² − a².
That adds the lengths. The leg must be shorter than the hypotenuse.
64 is the square of the leg (100 − 36). Take the square root.

hints.en: The hypotenuse is the longest side, so it is c in a² + b² = c².
Subtract the square of the known leg from the square of the hypotenuse.
Take the square root of the result.

objective: Identify the ordered pair that satisfies both equations of a system.

stem.en: Which ordered pair makes both equations true: y = x + 2 and y = 2x − 1?
stem.es: ¿Qué par ordenado hace verdaderas las dos ecuaciones: y = x + 2 y y = 2x − 1?

choices.why: (1, 3) works in y = x + 2, but 2(1) − 1 = 1, not 3. A solution must work in both equations.
The x and y values are swapped. In (x, y) the x-value comes first.
(2, 3) works in y = 2x − 1, but 2 + 2 = 4, not 3. It fails the first equation.

hints.en: A solution must make both equations true at the same time.
Substitute each pair into both equations.
Count how many equations each pair satisfies.

steps: The other pairs fail at least one equation.
solution.es: Con (3, 5): 3 + 2 = 5 y 2(3) − 1 = 5; las otras fallan en una ecuación.

objective: Explain why a system of parallel lines has no solution using the graph and the equations.

stem.en: Explain why the system y = 2x + 3 and y = 2x − 4 has no solution. Use both what the graph looks like and what happens when you set the right sides equal.
stem.es: Explica por qué el sistema y = 2x + 3 y y = 2x − 4 no tiene solución. Usa cómo se ven las gráficas y lo que pasa al igualar los lados derechos.

criteria.en: Notes both lines have slope 2 and different y-intercepts, so they are parallel
criteria.es: Observa que ambas rectas tienen pendiente 2 e intersecciones distintas, así que son paralelas

criteria.en: Sets 2x + 3 = 2x − 4 and gets a false statement such as 3 = −4
criteria.es: Iguala 2x + 3 = 2x − 4 y obtiene un enunciado falso como 3 = −4

criteria.en: Concludes the lines never meet, so there is no solution
criteria.es: Concluye que las rectas nunca se cruzan, así que no hay solución

sample.en: Both lines have slope 2 but different y-intercepts (3 and −4), so they are parallel and never meet. Setting 2x + 3 = 2x − 4 gives 3 = −4, which is false. So there is no solution.
sample.es: Ambas rectas tienen pendiente 2 pero intersecciones distintas (3 y −4), así que son paralelas y nunca se cruzan. Al igualar 2x + 3 = 2x − 4 se obtiene 3 = −4, que es falso. Entonces no hay solución.

hints.en: Look at the slope and the y-intercept of each line.
What happens if you subtract 2x from both sides of 2x + 3 = 2x − 4?
Say what the false statement tells you about whether the lines ever meet.

steps: Same slope 2, different intercepts: parallel lines.
solution.es: Misma pendiente 2 e intersecciones distintas: paralelas; 3 = −4 es falso, no hay solución.

objective: Convert a count from a two-way table into a percent of the total.

stem.en: A two-way table shows that 15 of the 60 surveyed students are in 6th grade. What percent of the surveyed students are in 6th grade?
stem.es: Una tabla de doble entrada muestra que 15 de los 60 estudiantes encuestados están en 6.º grado. ¿Qué porcentaje de los estudiantes encuestados está en 6.º grado?

choices.why: 15 is the number of students, not the percent. Divide 15 by the total 60.
That divides 60 by 15 (the reverse). Divide the part by the whole.
That subtracts 100 − 60. A percent is the part divided by the whole.

hints.en: A percent compares the part with the whole.
Write the part over the whole as a fraction.
Convert the fraction to a percent.

objective: Compare the unit rates of two proportional relationships given in different forms.

stem.en: Plan A costs y = 0.15x dollars for x minutes. Plan B's graph is a line through (0, 0) and (20, 4). How many more dollars per minute does Plan B charge than Plan A?
stem.es: El Plan A cuesta y = 0.15x dólares por x minutos. La gráfica del Plan B es una recta que pasa por (0, 0) y (20, 4). ¿Cuántos dólares más por minuto cobra el Plan B que el Plan A?

hints.en: Plan A's rate is the number multiplied by x.
Find Plan B's rate by dividing y by x at the point (20, 4).
Subtract the two rates, the larger minus the smaller.

steps: Plan B rate = 4 ÷ 20 = 0.20 dollar per minute.
solution.es: Tasa del Plan B = 4 ÷ 20 = 0.20; 0.20 − 0.15 = 0.05 dólares más por minuto.

objective: Compare data sizes written as powers of ten using the quotient rule.

stem.en: A photo file holds 10⁵ bytes of data and a video file holds 10⁸ bytes. How many times as much data is in the video file?
stem.es: Un archivo de foto tiene 10⁵ bytes de datos y un archivo de video tiene 10⁸ bytes. ¿Cuántas veces más datos tiene el archivo de video?

criteria.en: Writes the quotient 10⁸ ÷ 10⁵ or subtracts the exponents
criteria.es: Escribe el cociente 10⁸ ÷ 10⁵ o resta los exponentes

criteria.en: Finds 10³, which is 1,000 times
criteria.es: Halla 10³, que es 1,000 veces

sample.en: 10⁸ ÷ 10⁵ = 10³, so the video holds 1,000 times as much data.
sample.es: 10⁸ ÷ 10⁵ = 10³, así que el video tiene 1,000 veces más datos.

hints.en: To compare sizes, divide the larger amount by the smaller one.
Use the rule for dividing powers with the same base.
Subtract the exponents and write the result as a power of ten.

objective: Solve a proportion from similar rectangles.

stem.en: Two picture frames are similar rectangles. The small frame is 4 inches wide and 6 inches tall. The large frame is x inches wide and 15 inches tall. Solve x/4 = 15/6 for x.
stem.es: Dos marcos de fotos son rectángulos semejantes. El marco pequeño mide 4 pulgadas de ancho y 6 de alto. El marco grande mide x pulgadas de ancho y 15 de alto. Resuelve x/4 = 15/6 para x.

hints.en: The ratio of width to height is the same for both frames.
Multiply both sides of the equation by 4.
Simplify 15/6 first if that helps.

objective: Plot a point from a linear model of growth.

stem.en: A plant is 8 centimeters tall and grows 3 centimeters each week. Plot the point (x, y) that shows its height y after x = 4 weeks.
stem.es: Una planta mide 8 centímetros de alto y crece 3 centímetros cada semana. Marca el punto (x, y) que muestra su altura y después de x = 4 semanas.

hints.en: Write the height as the starting height plus growth for x weeks.
Multiply the weekly growth by 4.
Add the starting height to that growth.

objective: Plot the point that shows the unit rate of a proportional relationship.

stem.en: A bike moves at a constant 5 meters every second. Plot the point (1, y) that shows the distance after 1 second. Use x for seconds and y for meters.
stem.es: Una bicicleta se mueve a una rapidez constante de 5 metros cada segundo. Marca el punto (1, y) que muestra la distancia después de 1 segundo. Usa x para los segundos y y para los metros.

hints.en: Time is on the horizontal axis and distance is on the vertical axis.
The point for 1 second is on the vertical line x = 1.
Move up as many units as the meters traveled in one second.

steps: After 1 second the bike has gone 5 × 1 = 5 meters.
solution.es: Después de 1 segundo la bicicleta recorre 5 metros: marca (1, 5).

objective: Plot a point at a given distance from the origin using the Pythagorean theorem.

stem.en: Plot a point in the first quadrant that is exactly 10 units from the origin and has an x-coordinate of 6.
stem.es: Marca un punto en el primer cuadrante que esté exactamente a 10 unidades del origen y tenga coordenada x igual a 6.

hints.en: The distance from the origin is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs x and y.
Write 6² + y² = 10².
Solve for the positive value of y.

solution.es: 6² + y² = 100 da y² = 64, así que y = 8. Marca (6, 8).

objective: Construct a scatter plot from a data pattern.

stem.en: A coach records push-ups. In week 1 an athlete does 10, and each week after that adds 4 more. Plot the points (week, push-ups) for weeks 1 to 4.
stem.es: Un entrenador anota las flexiones. En la semana 1 un atleta hace 10, y cada semana después hace 4 más. Marca los puntos (semana, flexiones) para las semanas 1 a 4.

hints.en: Week 1 is the point (1, 10).
Add 4 to the push-ups for each new week.
Plot all four ordered pairs, one for each week.

solution.es: Semana 2: 14; semana 3: 18; semana 4: 22. Marca los cuatro puntos.

objective: Plot the image of a point reflected across the x-axis.

stem.en: Point A is at (3, −2). Plot the image of A after a reflection across the x-axis.
stem.es: El punto A está en (3, −2). Marca la imagen de A después de una reflexión sobre el eje x.

hints.en: A reflection across the x-axis flips a point over the horizontal axis.
The x-coordinate stays the same.
The y-coordinate changes to its opposite.

solution.es: Sobre el eje x, (x, y) → (x, −y); (3, −2) pasa a (3, 2).

objective: Plot two points on a trend line to draw it.

stem.en: A trend line for a scatter plot has the equation y = 0.5x + 3. Plot the point where it crosses the y-axis and the point where x = 4.
stem.es: Una recta de tendencia de un diagrama de dispersión tiene la ecuación y = 0.5x + 3. Marca el punto donde cruza el eje y y el punto donde x = 4.

hints.en: The line crosses the y-axis where x = 0.
Substitute x = 0 and then x = 4 into the equation.
Plot the two ordered pairs.

solution.es: x = 0 da y = 3 y x = 4 da y = 5: marca (0, 3) y (4, 5).

objective: Plot points that satisfy a linear equation.

stem.en: Plot the two points on the graph of y = 2x − 1 that have x = 1 and x = 3.
stem.es: Marca los dos puntos de la gráfica de y = 2x − 1 que tienen x = 1 y x = 3.

hints.en: Substitute each x-value into the equation to find y.
For x = 1, double 1 and then subtract 1.
Plot the two ordered pairs on the grid.

solution.es: x = 1 da y = 1 y x = 3 da y = 5: marca (1, 1) y (3, 5).

objective: Explain with algebra why 0.999… equals 1.

stem.en: A friend says 0.999… is a little less than 1 because it never reaches 1. Use x = 0.999… and subtraction to explain whether your friend is right.
stem.es: Un amigo dice que 0.999… es un poco menos que 1 porque nunca llega a 1. Usa x = 0.999… y una resta para explicar si tu amigo tiene razón.

criteria.en: Sets x = 0.999… and writes 10x = 9.999…
criteria.es: Plantea x = 0.999… y escribe 10x = 9.999…

criteria.en: Subtracts to get 9x = 9
criteria.es: Resta para obtener 9x = 9

criteria.en: Concludes x = 1, so 0.999… equals 1
criteria.es: Concluye que x = 1, así que 0.999… es igual a 1

sample.en: Let x = 0.999… Then 10x = 9.999… Subtracting gives 9x = 9, so x = 1. The friend is wrong: 0.999… equals 1.
sample.es: Sea x = 0.999… Entonces 10x = 9.999… Al restar, 9x = 9, así que x = 1. El amigo se equivoca: 0.999… es igual a 1.

hints.en: Write x = 0.999… and then write 10x.
Subtract the first equation from the second so the 9s after the decimal point cancel.
Solve the equation you get for x.

objective: Identify ordered pairs that lie on the graph of a linear function.

stem.en: Select ALL of the ordered pairs that lie on the graph of y = 3x − 1.
stem.es: Selecciona TODOS los pares ordenados que están en la gráfica de y = 3x − 1.

choices.why: 3(3) − 1 = 8, not 9, so this point is not on the line.
3(1) − 1 = 2, not 3, so this point is not on the line.

hints.en: A point is on the graph when its y-value equals 3x − 1.
Substitute each x-value into the rule.
Compare the result with the y-value in the pair.

steps: x = 2 gives 5, x = 0 gives −1 and x = 4 gives 11, which match.
x = 3 gives 8 and x = 1 gives 2, which do not match.
solution.es: (2, 5), (0, −1) y (4, 11) cumplen y = 3x − 1; los otros dos no.

objective: Write a linear expression from a rate and an initial amount.

stem.en: A pool already has 40 gallons of water. A hose adds 15 gallons each minute. Write an expression for the gallons of water after x minutes.
stem.es: Una piscina ya tiene 40 galones de agua. Una manguera agrega 15 galones cada minuto. Escribe una expresión para los galones de agua después de x minutos.

hints.en: The amount that changes each minute is multiplied by x.
The starting amount is added once.
Combine the rate times x with the starting amount.

steps: Water added in x minutes is 15x.
solution.es: El agua agregada en x minutos es 15x; el total es 15x + 40.

objective: Apply the power-of-a-power rule.

stem.en: Zoe writes (7²)³ as 7 raised to one exponent. What exponent should she use?
stem.es: Zoe escribe (7²)³ como 7 elevado a un solo exponente. ¿Qué exponente debe usar?

hints.en: (7²)³ means 7² multiplied by itself 3 times.
Count how many factors of 7 appear in all.
Each of the 3 copies of 7² has the same number of factors.

objective: Match power expressions to their values.

stem.en: Match each power expression to its value.
stem.es: Relaciona cada expresión con potencias con su valor.

hints.en: Use the exponent rules before you multiply everything out.
Multiplying same bases adds exponents; dividing subtracts them.
Any nonzero number to the power 0 is 1.

objective: Use a linear model to find the input that gives a target output.

stem.en: A model predicts a typing score y from practice hours x with y = 1.5x + 8. How many hours of practice does the model predict for a score of 26?
stem.es: Un modelo predice una puntuación de mecanografía y a partir de las horas de práctica x con y = 1.5x + 8. ¿Cuántas horas de práctica predice el modelo para una puntuación de 26?

criteria.en: Writes 1.5x + 8 = 26
criteria.es: Escribe 1.5x + 8 = 26

criteria.en: Solves to get x = 12 hours
criteria.es: Resuelve y obtiene x = 12 horas

sample.en: Set 1.5x + 8 = 26. Subtract 8 to get 1.5x = 18, so x = 12 hours.
sample.es: Plantea 1.5x + 8 = 26. Resta 8 para obtener 1.5x = 18, así que x = 12 horas.

hints.en: Replace y with the target score.
Undo the constant first.
Then divide by the slope.

objective: Select the properties preserved by all rotations, reflections and translations.

stem.en: Select ALL of the properties that are kept the same by every rotation, reflection and translation.
stem.es: Selecciona TODAS las propiedades que se conservan en toda rotación, reflexión y traslación.

text.es: Las rectas paralelas siguen siendo paralelas

choices.why: Every one of these motions moves the figure, so its location changes.

text.en: Direction the vertices are listed (clockwise or counterclockwise)
text.es: Dirección en que se listan los vértices (horario o antihorario)

choices.why: A reflection reverses the order of the vertices, so the direction does not stay the same.

hints.en: These motions only move a figure; they do not stretch or squeeze it.
Think about which measurements stay the same when you slide, flip or turn a shape.
Check whether each property could change in a reflection.

steps: Rotations, reflections and translations preserve lengths, angles and parallelism.
They move the figure, and a reflection also reverses its direction.
solution.es: Conservan longitudes, ángulos y paralelismo; mueven la figura y la reflexión invierte la dirección.

verify.note: Identifying invariants of rigid motions is a conceptual judgment rather than a numeric computation.

objective: Find the error in applying a power to a product.

stem.en: Priya simplifies (2x³)⁴. Step 1: 2⁴ · (x³)⁴. Step 2: 2⁴ = 16. Step 3: (x³)⁴ = x⁷. Step 4: 16x⁷. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Priya simplifica (2x³)⁴. Paso 1: 2⁴ · (x³)⁴. Paso 2: 2⁴ = 16. Paso 3: (x³)⁴ = x⁷. Paso 4: 16x⁷. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

hints.en: Check each step by redoing it a different way.
Test the rule used when a power is raised to another power.
Compare 3 + 4 with 3 × 4 for (x³)⁴.

steps: Step 1 applies the exponent to both factors, which is right.
(x³)⁴ multiplies the exponents: x¹², not x⁷.
solution.es: (x³)⁴ = x³ˣ⁴ = x¹², no x⁷; el resultado es 16x¹².

objective: Use the product rule for powers with the same base.

stem.en: Which expression is equivalent to 5³ · 5⁴?
stem.es: ¿Qué expresión es equivalente a 5³ · 5⁴?

choices.why: That multiplies the exponents. When you multiply powers with the same base, you add the exponents.
The base stays 5. Multiplying the two powers does not multiply the bases.
Adding 5 + 5 changes the base. The base stays 5; only the exponents combine.

hints.en: Write each power as repeated multiplication.
Count how many factors of 5 there are in all.
Combine the exponents using the rule for the same base.

steps: 5³ has three factors of 5 and 5⁴ has four.
solution.es: 5³ tiene tres factores de 5 y 5⁴ tiene cuatro: en total 5⁷.

objective: Multiply numbers in scientific notation.

stem.en: A factory makes 3 × 10⁴ parts in a week, and runs for 2 × 10³ weeks over its lifetime. The total is 6 × 10ⁿ. What is n?
stem.es: Una fábrica hace 3 × 10⁴ piezas por semana y funciona durante 2 × 10³ semanas en toda su vida. El total es 6 × 10ⁿ. ¿Cuál es n?

hints.en: Multiply the single digits and the powers of ten separately.
When you multiply powers of ten, add the exponents.
3 × 2 gives the 6; now combine 10⁴ and 10³.

objective: Use the slope of a proportional graph to find an input for a given output.

stem.en: The graph of a pump is a line through the origin with slope 4, so y = 4x gives gallons y after x minutes. After how many minutes does the tank hold 52 gallons? Solve 4x = 52.
stem.es: La gráfica de una bomba es una recta que pasa por el origen con pendiente 4, así que y = 4x da los galones y después de x minutos. ¿Después de cuántos minutos el tanque tiene 52 galones? Resuelve 4x = 52.

hints.en: The slope 4 means 4 gallons are added every minute.
Undo the multiplication by 4.
Divide both sides of the equation by 4.

solution.es: Divide ambos lados entre 4: x = 52 ÷ 4 = 13 minutos.

objective: Find a rational square root of a fraction in a context.

stem.en: A square quilt panel has an area of 49/64 square yard. How long is one side of the panel, in yards?
stem.es: Un panel cuadrado de colcha tiene un área de 49/64 de yarda cuadrada. ¿Cuánto mide un lado del panel, en yardas?

hints.en: The side length times itself equals the area.
Take the square root of the top and of the bottom separately.
Both 49 and 64 are perfect squares.

steps: √49 = 7 and √64 = 8, so the side is 7/8 yard.

objective: Evaluate a function rule for a given input.

stem.en: A quiz game gives points by the function P(n) = 3n − 2, where n is the number of correct answers. How many points are earned for n = 4?
stem.es: Un juego de preguntas da puntos con la función P(n) = 3n − 2, donde n es el número de respuestas correctas. ¿Cuántos puntos se ganan con n = 4?

hints.en: Replace n in the rule with the given input.
Multiply 3 by the input first.
Then subtract 2.

objective: Use the quotient rule to simplify a variable expression.

stem.en: A population model divides x⁹ by x⁴. Write the result as a single power of x (x is not 0).
stem.es: Un modelo de población divide x⁹ entre x⁴. Escribe el resultado como una sola potencia de x (x no es 0).

hints.en: Dividing removes common factors of x from the top and bottom.
Count the factors of x left after cancelling.
For the same base, subtract the exponents.

steps: x⁹ ÷ x⁴ cancels four factors of x.
Five factors of x remain: x⁵.

objective: Compute the slope of a line from the legs of a slope triangle.

stem.en: A ramp is drawn as a line. A slope triangle under it has a horizontal leg of 6 units and a vertical leg of 4 units. What is the slope of the ramp as a fraction in simplest form?
stem.es: Una rampa se dibuja como una recta. Un triángulo de pendiente debajo de ella tiene un cateto horizontal de 6 unidades y uno vertical de 4 unidades. ¿Cuál es la pendiente de la rampa como fracción en su forma más simple?

hints.en: Slope compares the vertical change with the horizontal change.
Write the vertical leg over the horizontal leg.
Simplify the fraction you get.

objective: Find the rate of change from two rows of a table.

stem.en: A table for a bakery's profit shows $7 after 2 hours and $19 after 6 hours. Assuming the relationship is linear, what is the rate of change in dollars per hour?
stem.es: Una tabla de las ganancias de una panadería muestra $7 después de 2 horas y $19 después de 6 horas. Suponiendo que la relación es lineal, ¿cuál es la tasa de cambio en dólares por hora?

hints.en: The rate of change is the change in profit divided by the change in time.
Subtract the two profits, then subtract the two times.
Divide the profit change by the time change.

solution.es: Cambio en ganancia 12, cambio en tiempo 4; 12 ÷ 4 = 3 dólares por hora.

objective: Classify functions given in different forms by their rate of change.

stem.en: Sort each function by its rate of change: is it greater than 3 or less than 3?
stem.es: Clasifica cada función según su tasa de cambio: ¿es mayor que 3 o menor que 3?

hints.en: Find the rate of each function: the change in y for a change of 1 in x.
For a table or two points, divide the change in y by the change in x.
Compare each rate with 3.

solution.es: Tasas mayores que 3: 4, 5 y 5; menores que 3: 2, 2 y 0.5.

objective: Sort numbers into rational and irrational.

stem.en: Sort each number into the correct group: rational or irrational.
stem.es: Clasifica cada número en el grupo correcto: racional o irracional.

hints.en: A rational number can be written as a fraction of two integers.
A square root is rational only when the number under the root is a perfect square.
Decide whether 49, 30 and 50 are perfect squares.

steps: 5/8 is a fraction, √49 = 7, and 0.333… = 1/3, so all three are rational.
30 and 50 are not perfect squares, so √30 and √50 are irrational; π is irrational.
solution.es: 5/8, √49 = 7 y 0.333… = 1/3 son racionales; √30, √50 y π son irracionales.

objective: Use angle preservation under reflection to find an angle in the image.

stem.en: Triangle ABC has angles of 35° and 65°. It is reflected across a line to make triangle A′B′C′. What is the measure of angle C′ in degrees?
stem.es: El triángulo ABC tiene ángulos de 35° y 65°. Se refleja sobre una recta para formar el triángulo A′B′C′. ¿Cuál es la medida del ángulo C′ en grados?

hints.en: Reflections preserve angle measures, so C′ equals angle C.
Find angle C using the angle sum of a triangle.
Subtract the two known angles from 180.

steps: Angle C = 80°, and a reflection keeps it, so angle C′ = 80°.
solution.es: Ángulo C = 180° − 35° − 65° = 80°, y la reflexión lo conserva.

objective: Identify the fraction equal to a one-digit repeating decimal.

stem.en: Which fraction is equal to 0.444… (the digit 4 repeats forever)?
stem.es: ¿Qué fracción es igual a 0.444… (el dígito 4 se repite para siempre)?

choices.why: 2/5 is exactly 0.4 and stops. The decimal 0.444… keeps going.
4/99 is 0.0404…, a different repeating decimal. One repeating digit goes over 9.
44/100 is exactly 0.44 and stops. It is not 0.444…

hints.en: Every repeating decimal is a rational number, so it can be written as a fraction.
Let x = 0.444… and multiply by 10 to line up the repeating digits.
Subtract x from 10x and see what 9x equals.

objective: Find the flawed reasoning in deciding whether a relation is a function.

stem.en: Kim says {(1, 2), (2, 4), (1, 5)} is a function. Step 1: The inputs are 1, 2 and 1. Step 2: The outputs 2, 4 and 5 are all different. Step 3: So the relation is a function. Which step has the mistake in reasoning?
stem.es: Kim dice que {(1, 2), (2, 4), (1, 5)} es una función. Paso 1: Las entradas son 1, 2 y 1. Paso 2: Las salidas 2, 4 y 5 son todas diferentes. Paso 3: Entonces la relación es una función. ¿Qué paso tiene el error de razonamiento?

steps: The outputs 2, 4 and 5 are all different
So the relation is a function

hints.en: Recall what a function requires of its inputs.
Different outputs are allowed, but one input cannot have two outputs.
Look at what happens to the input 1.

steps: The input 1 has two outputs, 2 and 5.
So it is not a function. Different outputs do not matter; repeated inputs with different outputs do.
solution.es: La entrada 1 tiene dos salidas, 2 y 5, así que no es función.

objective: Convert a two-digit repeating decimal to a fraction in simplest form.

stem.en: A calculator shows 0.272727… with the digits 27 repeating forever. Write this number as a fraction in simplest form.
stem.es: Una calculadora muestra 0.272727… con los dígitos 27 repitiéndose para siempre. Escribe este número como una fracción en su forma más simple.

hints.en: Two digits repeat, so multiply the number by 100 to shift one full block.
Subtract the original number from 100 times the number so the repeating tails cancel.
You will get 99 times the number equal to the repeating block. Then simplify.

objective: Convert a two-digit repeating decimal to a fraction.

stem.en: Convert 0.181818… (the digits 18 repeat forever) into a fraction in simplest form.
stem.es: Convierte 0.181818… (los dígitos 18 se repiten para siempre) en una fracción en su forma más simple.

hints.en: Two digits repeat, so put the repeating block over 99.
Write 18 over 99.
Simplify by dividing top and bottom by 9.

objective: Place a one-digit repeating decimal on a number line by converting it to a fraction.

stem.en: The decimal 0.666… (the 6 repeats forever) is a rational number. Place a point at its value on the number line.
stem.es: El decimal 0.666… (el 6 se repite para siempre) es un número racional. Coloca un punto en su valor en la recta numérica.

hints.en: Write the repeating decimal as a fraction first.
A single repeating digit goes over 9.
Simplify the fraction and find it on the line cut into thirds.

steps: 6/9 = 2/3, which is the second tick after 0.

objective: Compute a residual as the actual value minus the predicted value.

stem.en: A model predicts that a student who studies 3 hours scores 52. The student actually scored 47. What is the residual, found as actual minus predicted?
stem.es: Un modelo predice que un estudiante que estudia 3 horas obtiene 52. En realidad el estudiante obtuvo 47. ¿Cuál es el residuo, calculado como valor real menos valor predicho?

hints.en: A residual compares what really happened with what the model said.
Start with the actual score.
Subtract the predicted score from the actual score and keep the sign.

steps: 47 − 52 = −5, so the point is 5 below the model.
solution.es: Residuo = 47 − 52 = −5: el punto está 5 por debajo del modelo.

objective: Find a residual when the actual value is above the prediction.

stem.en: A line of fit predicts that a plant will be 80 millimeters tall at week 6. The plant is actually 86 millimeters tall. What is the residual, found as actual minus predicted?
stem.es: Una recta de ajuste predice que una planta medirá 80 milímetros en la semana 6. La planta en realidad mide 86 milímetros. ¿Cuál es el residuo, calculado como valor real menos valor predicho?

hints.en: A residual compares the real value with the model's value.
Put the actual value first in the subtraction.
Subtract 80 from 86.

steps: 86 − 80 = 6, so the plant is 6 millimeters above the line.
solution.es: Residuo = 86 − 80 = 6 milímetros por encima de la recta.

objective: Rewrite a linear equation in slope-intercept form.

stem.en: Rewrite the equation 2y = −4x + 12 as y = mx + b by writing the expression that equals y.
stem.es: Reescribe la ecuación 2y = −4x + 12 como y = mx + b escribiendo la expresión que es igual a y.

hints.en: You need y by itself on one side.
Divide every term on the right side by the same number.
Divide both −4x and 12 by 2.

objective: Find the third angle of a right triangle.

stem.en: A right triangle has a 90° angle and a 25° angle. What is the measure of the third angle?
stem.es: Un triángulo rectángulo tiene un ángulo de 90° y un ángulo de 25°. ¿Cuánto mide el tercer ángulo?

choices.why: 115° is 90° + 25°. The angles add to 180°, so subtract that sum from 180°.
That subtracts only 25° from 180°. The right angle also uses 90°.
25° is the angle you were given. Find the third one.

hints.en: The three angles of a triangle add to 180°.
Add the two angles you know.
Subtract that sum from 180°.

objective: Find the arithmetic error in using the triangle angle sum.

stem.en: A right triangle has one angle of 35°. Nate finds the third angle. Step 1: 90 + 35 = 115. Step 2: 180 − 115 = 65. Step 3: The third angle is 65°. Which step has the mistake?
stem.es: Un triángulo rectángulo tiene un ángulo de 35°. Nate halla el tercer ángulo. Paso 1: 90 + 35 = 115. Paso 2: 180 − 115 = 65. Paso 3: El tercer ángulo mide 65°. ¿Qué paso tiene el error?

hints.en: Check Nate's answer by adding all three angles.
Do 90, 35 and 65 add to 180?
Look closely at the first addition.

objective: Sort side-length triples by whether they form a right triangle.

stem.en: Sort each set of side lengths by whether it forms a right triangle.
stem.es: Clasifica cada conjunto de longitudes de lados según si forma un triángulo rectángulo.

hints.en: Square the two shorter sides and add them.
Compare the sum with the square of the longest side.
A right triangle needs the two to be exactly equal.

steps: For 6, 7, 10 the sum is 85 and 10² = 100; the other two sets also do not match.
solution.es: 5, 12, 13; 8, 15, 17 y 9, 12, 15 cumplen a² + b² = c²; los otros no.

objective: Select side-length sets that satisfy a² + b² = c².

stem.en: Select ALL of the side-length sets whose squares make a² + b² = c² true, with c the longest side.
stem.es: Selecciona TODOS los conjuntos de longitudes cuyos cuadrados hacen verdadera la igualdad a² + b² = c², con c el lado más largo.

choices.why: 4² + 5² = 41, but 6² = 36. The squares do not match.
7² + 8² = 113, but 9² = 81. The squares do not match.

hints.en: Square the two shorter sides and add them.
Compare the sum with the square of the longest side.
Mark a set only when the two are equal.

steps: The other two sets do not satisfy the equation.
solution.es: 3, 4, 5; 5, 12, 13 y 6, 8, 10 cumplen a² + b² = c²; los otros no.

objective: Locate a square root between two consecutive whole numbers.

stem.en: Which pair of consecutive whole numbers does √40 lie between?
stem.es: ¿Entre qué par de números enteros consecutivos se encuentra √40?

choices.why: 5² = 25 and 6² = 36 are both less than 40, so √40 is bigger than 6.
7² = 49 is already more than 40, so √40 is smaller than 7.
That takes half of 40. The square root asks which number times itself is near 40.

hints.en: Find a perfect square just below 40 and one just above 40.
Compare 40 with 6 × 6 and with 7 × 7.
The square root of a perfect square is a whole number, so 40 sits between two of them.

objective: Solve a one-variable equation with a fraction coefficient.

stem.en: One fourth of a rope's length plus 3 meters equals 9 meters. If x is the rope's length, then x/4 + 3 = 9. What is x, in meters?

hints.en: First undo the addition of 3.

Multiply both sides by 4 to undo the division.

objective: Recognize that a rotation preserves segment length.

stem.en: A line segment is 7 centimeters long. It is rotated 90° about a point. How long is the image of the segment?
stem.es: Un segmento de recta mide 7 centímetros de largo. Se gira 90° alrededor de un punto. ¿Cuánto mide la imagen del segmento?

A rotation does not shrink the segment. Its length stays the same.
90° is the angle of the turn, not a length.

hints.en: A rotation turns a figure around a point.
Think about whether turning a stick changes how long it is.
Rotations, reflections and translations keep lengths the same.

steps: A rotation is a rigid motion.
Rigid motions preserve length, so the image is still 7 centimeters.
solution.es: Una rotación es un movimiento rígido y conserva la longitud: 7 centímetros.

objective: Match coordinate rules to the transformations they describe.

Rules that add to a coordinate are translations.

objective: Compare the rates of change of two functions given as an equation and a table.

stem.en: Function A is y = 3x + 2. Function B has a table with the points (0, 5), (1, 7) and (2, 9). Which statement about their rates of change is true?
stem.es: La función A es y = 3x + 2. La función B tiene una tabla con los puntos (0, 5), (1, 7) y (2, 9). ¿Qué enunciado sobre sus tasas de cambio es verdadero?

text.en: Function A changes faster, at a rate of 3
text.es: La función A cambia más rápido, con una tasa de 3

text.en: Function B changes faster, at a rate of 2
text.es: La función B cambia más rápido, con una tasa de 2

choices.why: Function B's rate is 2, but Function A's rate is 3, and 3 is greater than 2.

choices.why: Function A has rate 3 and Function B has rate 2, so the rates are not equal.

text.en: Function B changes faster, at a rate of 5
text.es: La función B cambia más rápido, con una tasa de 5

Read A's rate from its equation and find B's rate from its table.
Subtract two y-values from the table for a 1-unit step in x.

Function B: 7 − 5 = 2 per step. Since 3 > 2, A changes faster.
solution.es: La función A tiene tasa 3 y la B tiene tasa 7 − 5 = 2; A cambia más rápido.

objective: Find a hypotenuse whose length is a fraction.

hints.en: The longest edge is the hypotenuse.
Square 3/2 by squaring the top and the bottom.
Add the squares using a common denominator and take the square root.

objective: Identify an equation with the same solution as a given equation.

objective: Compare two quantities written with single digits times negative powers of ten.

hints.en: To find how many times as large, divide the larger width by the smaller.
Rewrite 4 × 10⁻⁴ as 40 × 10⁻⁵ so both have the same power.
Divide 40 by 8.

criteria.es: Escribe 60 + 25w = 15 + 40w

objective: Solve an equation with variables on both sides.

Then add 4 to both sides and divide.

Add the fee to the price for m minutes.

criteria.es: Multiplica días, horas, minutos y segundos: 365 × 24 × 60 × 60

Multiply days by 24, then by 60, then by 60.
Write the product and round the leading digits to one digit.

objective: Find a cylinder's volume in terms of pi from radius and height.

objective: Use a square root to find a side length from an area.

stem.en: A square sign has an area of 144 square inches. How long is one side of the sign, in inches?

Use the square root.

objective: Explain why a dilated figure is similar but not congruent to the original.

stem.en: A triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5 is dilated by a scale factor of 2 to make a triangle with sides 6, 8 and 10. Explain why the two triangles are similar but not congruent.
stem.es: Un triángulo con lados de 3, 4 y 5 se dilata con un factor de escala de 2 para formar un triángulo con lados de 6, 8 y 10. Explica por qué los dos triángulos son semejantes pero no congruentes.

criteria.en: Shows each pair of matching sides has the same ratio: 6/3, 8/4 and 10/5 all equal 2
criteria.es: Muestra que cada par de lados correspondientes tiene la misma razón: 6/3, 8/4 y 10/5 son todos 2

criteria.es: Dice que la dilatación conserva los ángulos, así que la forma es la misma
